Content: Alpha particles are stable decay products of many nuclear disintegrations. An alpha particle consists of `text(two)` protons and `text(two)` neutrons and has a mass of `6.644xx10^-27` `text(kilogram)`. When the individual masses of `text(two)` protons and `text(two)` neutrons are added, the sum is `6.695xx10^-27` `text(kilogram)`. The difference between the mass of an alpha particle and the total mass of its `text(four)` individual component particles is called the mass defect.
